title: The Great Pyramid of Giza
about: when it was built, for which pharaoh, its height and its age. Include several specific numbers, dates or names where the topic has them, some exact and some rounded or hedged (about, nearly, more than, up to).
passages: The Great Pyramid of Giza rises from a rocky PLATEAU on the west bank of the Nile, just outside the modern city of Cairo in Egypt. It was built around 2560 BCE for the pharaoh Khufu, a king of Egypt's Fourth DYNASTY. That makes it about 4,500 years old, the oldest of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World and the only one still standing. When it was finished, it stood about 146 meters, or 481 feet, tall. For nearly 3,800 years, no structure built by people anywhere on Earth was taller.

Today it measures about 138 meters, because its smooth outer layer of white LIMESTONE was stripped away over the centuries. Builders used more than 2 million stone blocks, and some weighed up to 80 tonnes. The heaviest pink granite came from Aswan, roughly 800 kilometers up the Nile. Ancient Egyptians believed the pyramid would help Khufu's spirit journey into the afterlife. In 2013, archaeologists found the oldest known written PAPYRUS in Egypt, a logbook kept by an official named Merer. It describes his crew moving limestone by boat to Giza and shows that organized, well fed work teams built this wonder.
